proposals.evidence: Chatterji 1926 Part II, pp. 832–833 derives Gujarati ā “this” from ayam via aya/āa, contrasting the Rajasthani eta paradigm. The user explicitly chose the Gujarati analysis for the Bhil-language survey forms. Their ayam link is provisional about local inheritance versus Gujarati/other Indo-Aryan transmission. The primary grammar pages and prior withdrawal are preserved in chatterji-pronoun-primary.json and proximal-correction.json; the source spelling and nasalization are retained.
